notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests + bs4/lxml, Chrome UA) worked cleanly for every page - no blocks encountered. robots.txt checked first: generic 'User-agent: *' with only /downloads/, /system/, /sitecore/, /checkout/ and a testlang query-param disallow - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User entries, so no tier restriction; proceeded on tier (a) throughout, Playwright/Chrome never needed. TREE METHOD: full mega-menu extracted from homepage <nav> (Furniture: Chairs incl. Dining/Lounge/Barstools/Swivel/Benches/Chair Accessories, Beds, Sofas incl. 2/3-Seater/Modular/Sofa Cushion, Poufs & Stools, Tables, Storage incl. Shelving/Sideboards & Cabinets/Wardrobe Furniture, Rugs, Outdoor; Lighting; Accessories: Kitchen, Tableware, Candleholders, Organizing, Textiles incl. Throws & Cushion, Objects, Vases, Mirrors, Hooks & Shoehorns, Cleaning, Daily Fiction) - this union is authoritative; site's sitemap.xml/sitemap_index.xml both 500-error (not a bot block, endpoint just doesn't exist) so no additional sitemap cross-check was possible, mega-menu + each landing page's own sub-nav strip was used instead. Every recorded leaf's canonical <link> and <h1> were confirmed to match the requested node. QTY METHOD: each category listing page renders a hidden '.transientData' div with an exact 'data-totalhits' attribute (e.g. data-totalhits="34") tied to the site's internal search/filter widget - this is the authoritative product count and was used for every qty (cross-checked against the visible 'More results (N remaining)' button count on pages with pagination, e.g. Rugs showed 36 loaded + 'More results (16)' = data-totalhits 52, consistent). CROSS-VALIDATION: compared against the already-completed Furniture extraction (pipeline/furniture_json_archive/f147.json) - it captured Furniture > Storage > Shelving(26)/Sideboards & Cabinets(21)/Wardrobe Furniture(14) as genuine Furniture (bookcases, cabinets, wardrobes - explicitly under the site's Furniture mega-menu per storage.md Storage Furniture Boundary, so excluded here to avoid cross-category duplication), and confirmed it did NOT claim Rugs, Sofa Cushion, or Chair Accessories, supporting their classification here. TEXTILE INCLUDED: Furniture>Sofas>Sofa Cushion (8, textile.md SS4 explicit example 'Sofa Cushion -> Textile', furniture provides the sofa frame but the cushion itself is a fabric accessory sold separately) - grouped under 'Sofas' since that is the real site parent node; Furniture>Rugs (52, textile.md SS6 core textile/floor-covering category - the site files it under the Furniture mega-menu purely as navigation, the product itself is a fabric floor covering, and the Furniture worker did not claim it) - standalone leaf (Rugs has no further site subcategory); Accessories>Textiles>Throws & Cushion (3: 1 cushion + 2 throw blankets, textile.md SS3/SS4 core) - 'Textiles' kept as a grouping row per parent-URL rule (it has one valid child subcategory, so the Textiles URL itself is not recorded, only Throws & Cushion's). TEXTILE EXCLUDED: 'Yummy Tea Towel Sausage' - a single tea towel found embedded inside the general Accessories>Kitchen listing (25 products, otherwise all Kitchen & Dining glassware/boards/mills) - no distinct 'Tea Towels' subcategory/URL exists to isolate it from the Kitchen & Dining products on that page, so no row was forced per the no-fabricated-URL / no-forced-row rules; noting it here for the record rather than misclassifying the whole Kitchen page as Textile. STORAGE INCLUDED: Accessories>Organizing (34: storage baskets, toolboxes, office bins, laundry baskets, ring boxes, pocket organizers, nic-nac organizers - all confirmed via product meta-descriptions as genuine storage/organizing products, e.g. Nic Nac 'multi-functional organizer', Pocket Organizer 'decorative storage solution') - standalone leaf, no further site subcategory beneath Organizing. STORAGE EXCLUDED: Furniture>Storage>Shelving/Sideboards & Cabinets/Wardrobe Furniture (already Furniture per above); Accessories>Cleaning (4 items: washing-up brush, toilet brush - tools themselves, storage.md SS30 excludes the cleaning tools, and none of the 4 are a rack/holder/organizer); Accessories>Hooks & Shoehorns (37 items: wall hooks and shoehorns - hardware/personal-care items, not listed in any storage.md include category); Furniture>Chairs>Chair Accessories (0 products - confirmed empty listing page, h1 present but zero product cards, nothing to classify). NEITHER: Lighting (all subcats), Accessories>Kitchen/Tableware/Candleholders/Vases/Mirrors/Objects/Daily Fiction (glassware, candleholders, vases, mirrors, sculptures, stationery - Kitchen & Dining / Decorative Home Accessories / general-merchandise, out of scope for both rulesets), Furniture>Beds/Tables/Outdoor/Poufs & Stools (genuine furniture, already Furniture per f147.json), Collections/News/Journal/About/Professional/Download sections (not category listing pages). No duplicates: each recorded URL appears once, one page load per node informed both classification passes.
